desc:
GARAGE FIGHTS is a MMA fighting game. You draw every strike. Jab, hook, uppercut, body kick, head kick. 1v1 fights, won by knockout.

NEW FIGHT STYLES UPDATE HAPPENING
PUT YOUR OPPONENT IN A CHOKE, GROUND AND POUND, HEADBUTT THEM EVEN.

CODE: FIRSTBELL

CONTROLS
PC — WASD to move. Hold left mouse and draw. F to guard. SPACE to dodge, with A / D / S for the side.
PHONE — walk on the left of the screen, draw on the right. GUARD and DODGE sit bottom right.
CONTROLLER — left stick walks. RIGHT STICK draws: park it, then flick. L2 guards, R1 dodges.

New? Visit the coach or start some trainings to learn the strikes.
